extractor_note: THE ONLY QUANTITATIVE LINK-2 EVIDENCE IN THE CHAPTER, and it is a mediation proportion for DEPRESSION rather than for medication. 17% of the depression-fecundability association runs through intercourse frequency; 44% runs through psychotropic use and 19% through SSRI use specifically. The behavioural pathway the hypothesis is built on is the smallest of the three, in the one study that measured all of them.
